verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated through the API for use in your own case management system. Webhooks with idempotency keys, including WORKFLOW_COMPLETED payloads carrying screening results, and an OpenAPI/Postman collection support building that synchronization. missing for 10: explicit webhook events for case or decision changes, documented API endpoints for writing case decisions back, independent or hands-on corroboration of two-way sync.
